contract: Wonder strata, shared by native cubes and the DH preview through the crust's bed source; no block changes the land's shape. The cover a column's ground takes (sand, sandstone, gravel beaches, slopes, clay beds) is the column engine's setting table, riven-surface.json.

Exposed rock and all rock below the soil come from the geology (riven-geology.json); these palettes serve only wonders, banded in their top depthBlocks: strata thicknessBlocks thick, tilted by up to tiltBlocks over tiltWavelengthBlocks, each band picked by a hash of the band index.
